Index.title: Ertikaz International Contracting
Index.subtitle: Supply, installation, and maintenance of premium HVAC, Central Air Conditioning, VRF Systems, and integrated electromechanical (MEP) works in Saudi Arabia.
Index.about_desc: Ertikaz is a leading engineering contracting company in Saudi Arabia, specializing in the design, supply, installation, and maintenance of integrated building systems. We deliver top-tier HVAC & Ventilation, Plumbing, Fire Protection, and Electrical works for residential, commercial, and industrial sectors across the Kingdom.
Index.services_subtitle: Comprehensive electromechanical and cooling solutions designed for Saudi Arabia's extreme climate.
Index.serv_hvac_desc: State-of-the-art Central AC, Concealed Ducted Splits, VRF/VRV climate systems, and automated duct design & fabrication.
Index.serv_plumb_desc: Advanced water networks, high-pressure pump supply, structural plumbing, and sanitary systems installation.
Index.serv_fire_desc: Civil Defense approved fire alarms, high-grade firefighting sprinklers, and complete safety systems compliance.
Index.serv_elec_desc: Precision power distribution, custom control panels, intelligent lighting grids, and low-current installations.
Index.disassembly_subtitle: An exploded view of our high-efficiency AC systems, built with rust-resistant alloy and premium cooling cores.
Index.comp_desc: Saves up to 62% on electricity bills while maintaining absolute ambient cooling.
Index.filter_desc: Captures 99.97% of fine desert dust, pollens, and PM2.5 micro-particles.
Index.fan_desc: Delivers maximum cooling air volume (CFM) with near-silent acoustic performance.
Index.chassis_desc: Heavy-duty magnesium-aluminum alloy casing designed to withstand 50°C+ Saudi summer temperatures.
Index.catalog_subtitle: Authorized supplier of Daikin, Carrier, Gree, and O-General air conditioning units.
Index.unit_1_desc: Ideal for luxury villas and commercial towers. Highly efficient multi-zone cooling with independent temperature control.
Index.unit_2_desc: Designed for large-scale factories, malls, and skyscrapers. Robust engineering built for heavy-duty, high-capacity cooling.
Index.unit_3_desc: Ultra-slim design that fits seamlessly into your ceiling. High-power, quiet, and perfectly integrated with architectural layouts.
Index.unit_4_desc: Supreme performance for extreme desert climates. Fast cooling with extra-wide air throw for maximum indoor coverage.
Index.stats_subtitle: A legacy of trust, safety, and engineering excellence across Saudi Arabia.
